fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of Gross Sales but subject to tiered Royalty Incentive reductions: 6% on Gross Sales between $400,000-$500,000 in a calendar year, and 5% on Gross Sales exceeding $500,000 in a calendar year; resets annually. Royalty increases by 2.5% for franchisees that fail to timely renew after 60-day grace period. Ad Fund Contribution is 1.3% of Gross Sales per week. Local Marketing Obligation is an additional 0.7% of Gross Sales per week (paid to franchisee's own local marketing, not to franchisor, unless deficient). Technology Fee is $499/month per Franchised Business.
raw_excerpt: Royalty 7% of Gross Sales.
